title: Refinery order
description: One of the member's own refinery orders. The owner is always the member and is not carried. Amounts are whole units, 100 to the SCU; money is in aUEC.

id.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool, the feed key and the id the write operations name. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

clientKey.description: The key the creating client gave the order. Carried only to the client that created it.

createdBy.description: The client marker: the connected application that created the order. Absent for an order created in the web, a saved draft included.

name.description: The client's display name from the registry.

versions.description: The counters of the order's two sections. A write echoes the counter of each section it touches.

gameData.description: Location, refining method, timer, status, goods, pickup and store.

location.description: The refinery the order runs at.

method.description: The refining method; absent when none is set.

startedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC; absent when not set.

durationMinutes.description: The run's length; absent when not set.

endsAt.description: startedAt plus durationMinutes; absent while either is unset.

pickedUpAt.description: When a client reported the yield collected in the game; absent otherwise.

storedAt.description: When the yield was booked into stock; absent while it has not been. A stored order's status is locked.

expenses.description: The refining costs; absent when not set.

otherExpenses.description: Further costs; absent when not set.

oreSales.description: Revenue from selling raw ore; absent when not set.

missionId.description: The linked mission, by id only; absent when the order has none.

orgUnitId.description: The owning org unit, by id; absent for a personal order without one.

id.description: The good's row id, the id the goods operations name.

inputQuantity.description: Whole units, 100 to the SCU; 0 when the input amount is not known.
